defect.detail: The original V4 preregistration included PRIME_FACTOR_COUNT_MULTIPLICITY_MOD(k,r) as a selectable primitive family while the hidden target is parity of prime-factor count with multiplicity. That repeats the target-aligned-vocabulary defect discovered in V1.

evidenceOfNoContamination: No V4 implementation source existed when the defect was identified.
No V4 result receipt existed when the defect was identified.
The correction therefore tightens the benchmark before result observation rather than moving a goalpost after failure.
law: A preregistration can be superseded before execution when its benchmark is invalid, but the invalid preregistration remains preserved as lineage.
